europe_now.title: US Envoys Advance Ukraine Negotiations
europe_now.summary: American envoys traveled to Kyiv following substantive discussions with Russian leadership in Moscow regarding potential paths to peace. The diplomatic mission highlights ongoing international efforts to address the ongoing conflict in Eastern Europe.

europe_now.title: German Startup Reaches Space Milestone
europe_now.summary: A German aerospace startup achieved a major technological milestone by completing the region's first successful orbital launch. This development marks a significant advancement for commercial space capabilities within Europe.
